The <b>Hero's Memento</b> is a [[Materium#Mementos|Memento]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==

The memento can be displayed on a shelf in the [[Bellhome]] after interacting with the desk.

It appears in the bottom-middle slot of the shelving.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bellhome.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Bellhart 09.png!Displayed inside Bellhome in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Dropped by [[Lost Garmond]] after defeating him in [[Blasted Steps]] during the <i>[[Hero's Call]]</i> [[wish]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Lost Garmond 01.png!Lost Garmond location in Blasted Steps
|Image2 = Screenshot SS BlastedSteps 14.png!Lost Garmond in Blasted Steps
}}
